# Third-party source archive

`pystray-0.19.5-source.zip` is the unmodified upstream v0.19.5 source archive:

- Project: https://github.com/moses-palmer/pystray/tree/v0.19.5
- Download: https://codeload.github.com/moses-palmer/pystray/zip/refs/tags/v0.19.5
- SHA-256: `99fb0f7ec3a551e6c96d3946ecfce0e9dc04bac7994fa64ae348921a634af70e`
- Copyright: 2016-2022 Moses Palmér
- License: LGPL-3.0-or-later; see `COPYING.LGPL`, `COPYING`, and the source headers.

The archive includes the Python library, build files, documentation and tests.
It is not covered by MarbleScape's PolyForm Noncommercial license. The build
checks its digest and compares all installed pystray Python sources against
it before producing an executable. Modified dependencies require matching
source and updated notices; do not publish an old source archive with new code.

See [rebuilding instructions](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md#rebuilding-with-a-modified-pystray).
